content: Packagist shows current roave/security-advisories conflicts with illuminate/mail versions >=9,<12.60, which includes every Laravel 11 Illuminate Mail version; therefore changing its branch name cannot make a Laravel 11 graph resolvable. Composer native advisory policy and composer audit provide a non-conflicting replacement. Sources: packagist.org/packages/roave/security-advisories and getcomposer.org Composer config/CLI documentation.
